zh_CN: 保持货舱冷核稳定，监听电磁暴雪预警。

zh_CN: 已抵达白噪星轨道；准备进入冰原航路。
en: White Noise orbit reached; prepare for the icefield route.

zh_CN: 公司备注：冷核按“标准档案服务组件”登记，同时要求记录其批量访问接口是否可启用。
en: Company note: the cryocore is registered as a standard archive-service component, with a request to report whether its bulk-access interface can be enabled.

zh_CN: 当地封签：只恢复获准索引；私人记忆被找回，不代表获得公开授权。
en: Local seal: restore authorized indexes only; recovering private memories does not grant permission to publish them.

zh_CN: 白噪星地表约 1.28g。特高压电屏蔽罩得一直工作，护盾备用电源是可选保险，不是免撞许可证。
en: White Noise surface gravity is about 1.28g. High-voltage shielding must stay online; backup shield power is optional insurance, not a license to crash.

zh_CN: 电磁暴雪不只会把窗外刷白，还会沿着没屏蔽好的线路啃护盾。看不清时先稳住，别和风暴比谁更急。
en: The electromagnetic blizzard does more than white out the window; it chews through poorly shielded circuits. Stabilize when visibility drops instead of racing the storm.

zh_CN: 公司叫它标准维修件，当地封签却写着“只恢复获准索引”。一个零件也能决定谁有权读别人的生活。
en: The company calls it a standard repair part, while the local seal says authorized indexes only. Even a component can decide who gets to read someone else's life.

zh_CN: 离站完成。接下来是白噪星的强重力进场和电磁暴雪；屏蔽罩保线路，驾驶还是得靠你。
en: Departure complete. High-gravity entry and an electromagnetic blizzard are next; shielding protects the circuits, but you still have to fly.

zh_CN: 公司想把修复写成“恢复跨文明档案服务”。当地维护者要恢复的是能用、但不越权的检索。两句话只差几个字，权限差得很远。
en: The company calls it restoring inter-civilization archive service. Local maintainers want search restored without exceeding authorization. The wording is close; the access rights are not.

zh_CN: 还有，档案里的记忆是一个人留下的片段，不是整个人。别因为读到了记录，就替记录的主人决定该公开什么。
en: And memories in an archive are fragments left by a person, not the whole person. Reading a record does not let us decide what its owner should make public.

zh_CN: 公司频道正在循环播报：本次配送将扩展“标准化档案服务能力”。他们把“可能取得批量接口”念得像免费赠品。
en: The company channel keeps announcing that this delivery expands standardized archive-service capacity. They say possible bulk access as if it were a complimentary add-on.

zh_CN: 杂讯里夹着当地维护警告：恢复检索不等于取得公开授权。后半句被风暴切断了三次，但意思够清楚。
en: A local maintenance warning cuts through the static: restoring search does not grant publication rights. The blizzard chopped the sentence three times, but the meaning survived.

zh_CN: 冷核温度稳定。它会修复失效索引，也会把一项批量访问接口带到档案层门口。货舱里装的不只是替换件。
en: Cryocore temperature is stable. It will repair a failed index and bring a bulk-access interface to the archive layer's door. This is more than a replacement part.

zh_CN: 封签权限仍是最小访问。先把东西完整送到，再让有资格的人决定开哪扇门；我们不在航路上替他们签字。
en: The seal still requires minimum access. Deliver it intact, then let authorized people decide which door to open; we do not sign for them in transit.

zh_CN: 星光沿着舷窗边框缓慢后移。远处没有任何东西急着抵达。
en: Starlight drifts along the window frame. Nothing far away seems in a hurry to arrive.

zh_CN: 快递站的灯火退到窗框之外，星点开始加速后移。
en: The courier station lights slip beyond the frame as the stars begin to accelerate.

zh_CN: 航路稳定下来。群星掠过舷窗，远方一点暖红逐渐清晰。
en: The route steadies. Stars cross the window while a warm red point sharpens ahead.

zh_CN: 赤砂星已经占据前窗一角，大气辉光沿行星边缘亮起。
en: Red Sand fills a corner of the window, atmospheric light glowing along its rim.

同声传译器接通了。要是你听见一点水声，先别担心，通常不是故障。
en: The translator is online. If you hear a little water, do not worry. It is usually not a fault.

zh_CN: 先确认一下：你想按公司流程来，还是先看看设备？
en: First things first: follow company procedure, or inspect the equipment?

zh_CN: 按流程来。
先看看设备。
好。公司流程的优点是每一步都有编号，缺点是编号经常比步骤多。
en: Good. Every company step has a number. Unfortunately, there are often more numbers than steps.

zh_CN: 也行。先认清出口和咖啡机，通常比读完员工手册有用。
en: Fair. Finding the exit and coffee machine is usually more useful than finishing the handbook.

zh_CN: 准备好后，我们再看订单终端。慢慢来，宇宙暂时不会下班。
en: When you are ready, we will check the order terminal. Take your time; the universe is not clocking out yet.

zh_CN: 你就是新来的地球人？我是老皮。先别紧张，这座站目前还没塌过。
en: You must be the new human from Earth. I'm Lao Pi. Relax—this station has not collapsed yet.

zh_CN: 同声传译器亮着就行。亮着，我们是在聊天；灭了，我多半只是在对你叹气。
en: As long as the simultaneous translator is lit, we're talking. If it goes dark, I'm probably just sighing at you.

zh_CN: 先在大厅里走几步。公司叫这项“岗位空间熟悉”，我们通常叫别撞墙。
en: Walk around the hall first. The company calls it “workplace spatial familiarization.” We call it not walking into walls.

zh_CN: 不错。地板认得你的工牌，墙也暂时没记住你的脸。
en: Good. The floor recognizes your badge, and the walls have not memorized your face yet.

zh_CN: 现在靠近我，跟我打个招呼。会互动，比背完员工手册实用。
en: Now come over and say hello. Knowing how to interact is more useful than memorizing the employee handbook.

zh_CN: 这就对了。边境站人少，开口说话不用预约。
en: That's it. Border stations are quiet; you don't need an appointment to speak.

zh_CN: 公司把“有效同事沟通”列为必修，附录却比同事还多。
en: The company makes “effective colleague communication” mandatory. The appendix is longer than the staff list.

zh_CN: 最后去看一眼订单终端。先认清它，不用急着接单。
en: Last, take a look at the order terminal. Learn where it is; no need to accept anything yet.

zh_CN: 会走、会问，也找到终端了。第一天已经比维护记录完整。
en: You can walk, ask, and find the terminal. Your first day is already more complete than the maintenance log.

zh_CN: 慢慢来。这里现在不只我一个人值班了。
en: Take your time. I'm not the only one on duty here anymore.

zh_CN: 准备好，我们再看看今天送什么。
en: When you're ready, we'll see what needs delivering today.

zh_CN: 累了就歇会儿。订单不会跑，只会被公司标成“等待员工主动成长”。
en: Rest if you're tired. Orders don't run away; the company just marks them “awaiting proactive employee growth.”

zh_CN: 我在这儿。有事叫我，没事也可以。
en: I'm here. Call me if you need something—or if you don't.

zh_CN: 公司把报酬拆成基础款和货损修正，好像多写一行就能把风险算明白。钱到账就行。
en: The company split the payout into base pay and cargo adjustment, as if one extra line could explain the risk. At least the credits arrived.

zh_CN: 等等……那块旧中继铭牌刚才像是响了一下。也可能是站里的旧线路。先别替它写答案。
en: Wait... that old relay plaque sounded like it answered something. Could be the station wiring. Don't write an answer for it yet.

zh_CN: 挂到纪念墙吧。第一件放上去的东西不必解释一切，只要证明我们真的回来过。
en: Put it on the memorabilia wall. The first thing there does not need to explain everything; it only needs to prove we came back.

zh_CN: 订单接下了。冷却泵核心怕撞，先把防护配置看清。
en: Order accepted. The cooling pump core is impact-sensitive, so check the protective loadout first.

zh_CN: 激光炮不是必需品，不过陨石一般不接受公司流程培训。
en: The laser is optional, but asteroids generally refuse company procedure training.

zh_CN: 终端看完就去工作台。别急，公司把“准备充分”也算作一种延误。
en: Head to the workbench when you're done here. No rush—the company also classifies “being prepared” as a form of delay.

zh_CN: 赤砂星的冷却设备别摔。那边的风不讲人情，公司条款也不讲。
en: Don't drop Red Sand's cooling equipment. The wind has no mercy, and neither do the company terms.

zh_CN: 配置好了就叫我。我跟你一起去。
en: Call me when the loadout is ready. I'm going with you.

zh_CN: 窗外安静吧？公司把这段叫“非生产性航程”，我觉得他们没看过星星。
en: Quiet out there, isn't it? The company calls this “non-productive transit.” I don't think they've looked at the stars.

zh_CN: 别急着按导航。先坐稳，等你想走的时候再叫我。
en: No need to rush the navigation controls. Settle in, and call me when you feel like moving.

zh_CN: 航路稳下来了。引擎只剩低声响，说明我们和货物都还在该在的位置。
en: The route has settled. The engine is down to a low hum, which means we and the cargo are still where we belong.

zh_CN: 你装了激光炮。碰上陨石就用，别朝赤砂星挥手——公司会把那算成主动开拓客户关系。
en: You fitted the asteroid laser. Use it on rocks, not to wave at Red Sand—the company would log that as proactive customer outreach.

zh_CN: 没装激光炮也行。陨石带留了绕行口，慢一点；公司目前还没把谨慎列为设备故障。
en: No laser is fine. The asteroid belt has gaps, so take it slow; the company has not classified caution as equipment failure yet.

zh_CN: 再过一会儿就切到侧视飞行。我会提醒阶段，你照顾速度和姿态；真忙不过来，先保住船和货。
en: Side-view flight comes next. I'll call the stages; you manage speed and attitude. If it gets busy, protect the ship and cargo first.

zh_CN: 边境公共频段。有人报天气，有人找走失的维修机器人，听久了就知道这里还住着人。
en: Frontier public band. Weather reports, missing maintenance robots—listen long enough and you remember people still live out here.

zh_CN: 公司把它归类成“非必要噪声”。所以音量小点，别关。
en: The company classifies it as “non-essential noise.” Keep it low, then. Just don't turn it off.

zh_CN: 冷却泵核心读数很稳。它怕撞，不怕路远。
en: The cooling pump core reads steady. It minds impacts, not distance.

zh_CN: 同声传译接通了。我是伊娅，负责这片维修场。你送来的就是深层冷却泵核心？
en: The translator is connected. I'm Iya, and I maintain this yard. Is that the deep cooling pump core?

zh_CN: 把它接上，聚居地的冷却和净水还能撑过下一个风季。我不需要奇迹，只需要它别在最热的那周停。
en: Once it is connected, the settlement's cooling and water systems can last through the next wind season. I don't need a miracle—just for it not to stop during the hottest week.

zh_CN: 你从云层里扎下来的时候，整座场都在猜你先落地还是警报先烧坏。下次给设备一点预告。
en: When you punched through the clouds, the whole yard was betting on whether you or the alarms would land first. Give the equipment some warning next time.

zh_CN: 你在高空绕了很久。这里很少有人愿意慢下来看看沙海——通常公司只计算抵达分钟数。
en: You stayed high for a long while. Few people slow down to look at the sand sea; the company usually counts only arrival minutes.

zh_CN: 进场很稳。够快，也没让维修场的人把工具箱当掩体。
en: That was a steady approach—fast enough, without making the yard crew use their toolboxes as cover.

zh_CN: 核心外壳和密封都完好。我们今晚就能让第一组净水泵恢复运转。
en: The housing and seals are intact. We can bring the first water-purification bank online tonight.

zh_CN: 密封受过冲击，但还能修。我得先做一圈支撑架，净水泵会晚些启动，不会报废。
en: The seals took a hit, but they can be repaired. I'll brace the unit first; the water pumps will start later, not be lost.

zh_CN: 你带了陨石激光。这里没人反对你清航道，只是公司雷达会把武装货船记得格外清楚。
en: You brought the asteroid laser. No one minds you clearing the route, but company radar remembers armed freighters particularly well.

zh_CN: 你没带炮也穿过了陨石带。少一条武装记录，对这片维修场不算坏事。
en: You crossed the asteroid belt without a gun. One less armed-delivery record is not a bad thing for this yard.

zh_CN: 公司单据写的是“第 7 采掘区生产维护”，可这条管线先供工人住区。前几次冷却和净水订单都被改成“配额异常”；我不知道是谁改的。
en: The company manifest says “Extraction Zone 7 production maintenance,” but this line serves worker housing first. Earlier cooling and water orders were rewritten as “quota anomalies.” I don't know who changed them.

zh_CN: 我先校准核心。你可以在维修场走走，看看那台记录终端；它比公司的订单摘要诚实一点。
en: I'll calibrate the core. Walk around the yard and check the record terminal; it is a little more honest than the company summary.

zh_CN: 每个风季，我都要从三百多片散热栅里刮出矿砂。公司把这项工作登记成“自然清洁循环”。
en: Every wind season I scrape ore sand from more than three hundred cooling fins. The company records the work as a “natural cleaning cycle.”

zh_CN: 我们依赖公司的航线，也得学会在它的表格缝里活着。核心能运转，比谁在单据上赢了更重要。
en: We depend on company routes, and we learn to live between the lines of their forms. Getting the core running matters more than winning the paperwork.

zh_CN: 赤砂星那边等它的，不只是仓库编号。平稳送到就行，剩下的到了再看。
en: More than a warehouse number is waiting for it on Red Sand. Deliver it smoothly; we'll see the rest when we arrive.

zh_CN: 生物信号隔离舱

zh_CN: 横风稳定器

zh_CN: 样本关系到幼林病害隔离和迁徙窗口，其气味与信号会吸引本地生物。
en: The sample affects juvenile-grove disease isolation and migration windows, and its scent and signals attract local wildlife.

zh_CN: 天气塔共识钥
恢复跨城邦天气服务的标准控制组件；需避免盐雾放电与剧烈撞击。
en: A standard control component for restoring inter-city weather service; protect it from salt-spray discharge and heavy impact.

zh_CN: 组件的授权模式会决定谁能控制塔网、航路数据和天气窗口。
en: Its authorization mode determines who controls the tower network, route data, and weather windows.

zh_CN: 被退回的记忆盒
因授权记录不完整而退回的私人档案容器；外壳抗冲击能力有限。
en: A private archive container returned for incomplete authorization records, with limited impact protection.

zh_CN: 持有人只要求归还，不希望公司为家庭记录建立商业索引。
en: The owner asks only for its return and does not want a commercial index built for the family record.

zh_CN: 孢子稳定剂舱
供树冠诊疗点使用的生态稳定剂；必须在指定接收环完成低空投放。
en: An ecological stabilizer for a canopy clinic, to be delivered through its designated low-altitude receiving ring.

zh_CN: 货物用于处理孢子季呼吸问题，其信号会轻度吸引迁徙生物。
en: The cargo treats spore-season respiratory problems, while its signal mildly attracts migrating wildlife.

zh_CN: 民用航标电池组
用于恢复普通客运与渔业航标的耐候电池组。
en: Weatherproof cells for restoring navigation beacons used by civilian ferries and fishing routes.

zh_CN: 维护队的补给长期排在天气塔核心之后；下一段风墙前需要完成交付。
en: The maintenance crew's supplies have long ranked below tower cores, and delivery is needed before the next wind wall.

zh_CN: 旧铭牌的新外壳
en: A New Shell for the Old Plaque

zh_CN: 伊娅持续维护首单涉及的居民冷却与净水管线。
en: Iya continues maintaining the residential cooling and water lines from the first delivery.

zh_CN: 旧中继铭牌的纹路与公司现行设备标准不一致。
en: The old relay plaque's pattern does not match current company equipment standards.

zh_CN: 公司将本次改装登记为设备兼容性复核；完整进近已备案，本次使用维修服务航道跳过外层系统、陨石区和完整大气进入，接入验证后的后段安全走廊。
en: The company has filed this retrofit as an equipment compatibility review. The full approach is already logged, so this run uses a maintenance service lane that skips the outer system, asteroid zone, and full atmospheric entry before joining a verified late-route safe corridor.

zh_CN: 这次不是重走首单。完整进近已经备案，我们走维修服务航道，直接接入验证后的后段安全走廊。
en: This is not a repeat of the first delivery. The full approach is already logged; we are taking a maintenance service lane directly into a verified late-route safe corridor.

zh_CN: 等设施灯进入视野再开收音机。我想听听旧铭牌那层噪声会不会跟着维修载波一起出现。
en: Wait until the facility lights come into view before turning on the radio. I want to hear whether the old plaque's hidden noise rides with the maintenance carrier.

zh_CN: 维修服务航道已接通。它会跳过外层系统、陨石区和完整大气进入，不是假装我们又飞了一遍首单。
en: The maintenance service lane is connected. It skips the outer system, asteroid zone, and full atmospheric entry instead of pretending we flew the first delivery again.

zh_CN: 下面的净水与冷却设施都在运行。第一次来时那些灯是故障标记，现在是轮值班的工作灯。
en: The water and cooling facilities below are all operating. On our first visit those lights marked failures; now they are the night shift's work lights.

zh_CN: 伊娅要的不是标准护盾补片，而是一层能沿铭牌纹路绕开高压干扰的外壳。仪表只报噪声，可我又听见它了。
en: Iya did not request a standard shield patch, but an outer shell that routes high-voltage interference along the plaque pattern. The instruments report only noise, but I can hear it again.

zh_CN: 公司频道把本单称为“设备兼容性复核”，没有提居民管线，也没有提旧铭牌。
en: The company channel calls this order an equipment compatibility review. It mentions neither the residential lines nor the old plaque.

zh_CN: 维修载波下面有一层断续声，频率会贴着铭牌边缘移动。普通接收器仍把它当成噪声。
en: There is a broken sound beneath the maintenance carrier, its frequency moving along the plaque edge. The ordinary receiver still classifies it as noise.

zh_CN: 货舱里是非标准屏蔽材料，结构参数和伊娅传来的铭牌参考纹路一致。
en: The hold contains nonstandard shielding material whose structural parameters match the plaque reference pattern Iya transmitted.

zh_CN: 伊娅要我们把材料送到仍在运转的维修场，先核对净水与冷却管线，再校准屏蔽外壳。
en: Iya needs these materials delivered to the operating repair yard, where we will check the water and cooling lines before calibrating the shielding shell.

zh_CN: 你们回来得正好。那套冷却机没再停过，净水管也终于能按班次出水了。
en: Good timing. The cooling unit has not stopped again, and the water line can finally run on schedule.

zh_CN: 看见外面的灯了吗？以前那一排只在抢修时亮，现在夜班也有人守着。
en: See those lights outside? That row used to come on only during emergency repairs; now a night crew keeps watch.

zh_CN: 维修场现在多了两条管线和一班轮值的人。首单留下来的不只是公司结算单。
en: The yard has two new lines and a rotating maintenance crew now. Your first delivery left more than a company receipt.

zh_CN: 附近住区开始按时领水，几个原本要迁走的家庭也留下了。别误会，这还不是丰收，只是终于能安排明天。
en: The nearby district can collect water on schedule, and several families who planned to leave have stayed. It is not prosperity yet—just the ability to plan for tomorrow.

zh_CN: 但公司把新增需求都归进了“配额外消耗”。这批材料的用途，我只能先写成兼容性复核。
en: But the company classified every new need as off-quota consumption. For now I can only file these materials as a compatibility review.

zh_CN: 货箱封条完整。先把它接进校准架，普通护盾继续留在内层，高压屏蔽只走外壳回路。
en: The cargo seal is intact. We will connect it to the calibration rig; the normal shield stays inside while high-voltage shielding follows the hull circuit.

zh_CN: 铭牌上的纹路能把高压干扰绕开船壳。它比公司那套标准旧得多……我听校准音时，总觉得后面还有一层声音。
en: The plaque pattern can route high-voltage interference around the hull. It predates the company standard... and when I hear the calibration tone, there always seems to be another sound behind it.

zh_CN: 频率会跟着铭牌边缘移动，但普通检测器只看见噪声。我能确认它在回应，不能确认是谁、也不能确认为什么。
en: The frequency moves along the plaque edge, but ordinary detectors see only noise. I can confirm it responds—not who is responding or why.

zh_CN: 把这批屏蔽层送进旧校准架，我们就能做出一套不会替代普通护盾的外层。材料只有这一批，但改装不会收费。
en: Bring these shielding layers to the old calibration rig and we can build an outer layer that does not replace the regular shield. There is only one batch, but the retrofit is free.

zh_CN: 我会直接替你装到防护槽。回站后仍可在配置台拆换；这次安装只是保证下一段航路不会卡在手续上。
en: I will install it directly in the defense slot. You can swap it at the station workbench; this installation only keeps the next route from being blocked by procedure.

zh_CN: 改装完成后，公司会索要记录。你要上传完整纹路，还是只提交能通过审核的测试摘要？
en: After the retrofit, the company will request the records. Upload the full pattern, or submit only the test summary needed for approval?

zh_CN: 上传完整改装记录
只上传测试摘要，完整记录留在本地
en: Upload only the test summary and keep the full record local

zh_CN: 明白。公司会知道这套结构的全部细节，我会把居民设备的部分单独标记。
en: Understood. The company will know the full structure; I will mark the residential equipment section separately.

zh_CN: 好。我会提交兼容测试，把完整纹路留在维修场和你的船上。
en: All right. I will submit the compatibility test and keep the full pattern here and on your ship.

zh_CN: 先别说话……刚才那一声又来了。不是校准器故障，但我还说不清它是什么。
en: Quiet for a moment... there it is again. It is not a calibration fault, but I still cannot say what it is.

zh_CN: 那就只记作“异常回波”。我们知道它和铭牌有关，到这里为止；没有证据的答案不该写进档案。
en: Then record it only as an anomalous echo. We know it relates to the plaque, and no more; an answer without evidence does not belong in the archive.

zh_CN: 先把材料安全送到。等屏蔽层装好，你们才有资格穿过白噪星外层的电磁暴雪。
en: First bring the materials in safely. Once the shielding is installed, you will be qualified for the electromagnetic blizzard around White Noise.

zh_CN: 外层回路已经稳定。你下次来时，维修场应该还能认出这艘船。
en: The outer circuit is stable. When you return, the yard should still recognize this ship.

zh_CN: 我把那段回波标成了未解析，不会替它编一个答案。
en: I marked that echo as unresolved. I will not invent an answer for it.

zh_CN: 去白噪星前记得检查防护槽。拥有模块和装着模块不是一回事。
en: Check the defense slot before White Noise. Owning a module and installing it are not the same thing.

zh_CN: 这个旧终端的机柜一直在站里，只是没有索引。我把赤砂回访记录接进去了，电源还能用。
en: This old terminal cabinet has always been here, but it had no index. I connected the Red Sand revisit records, and its power still works.

zh_CN: 旧铭牌的数据补上了接口校验，档案现在接通了。白噪星公开维护日志里有一段相似的断续噪声。
en: The old plaque data completed the interface check, and the archive is online. White Noise's public maintenance logs contain a similar broken noise.

zh_CN: 先把它当成能核对的线索，不是答案。去之前也确认高压屏蔽仍装在防护槽。
en: Treat it as a clue we can verify, not an answer. Before departure, also confirm the high-voltage shielding remains installed.

en: Shielding materials delivered · Returning to the station

en: Inspect the operating water and cooling equipment

首单送来的核心正为住区供水与冷却；管线、蒸汽和轮值人员都已进入日常运行。
en: The core from the first order now supplies water and cooling to the district; pipes, steam, and rotating crews are part of daily operation.

zh_CN: 改装记录终端
记录尚未定稿。先与伊娅完成材料校准并决定提交范围。
en: The record is not finalized. Complete calibration with Iya and choose what to submit.

zh_CN: 完整改装纹路已上传公司；居民设备部分被单独标记。
en: The full retrofit pattern was uploaded to the company; residential equipment was marked separately.

zh_CN: 公司仅收到兼容测试摘要；完整纹路保留在维修场与飞船本地。
en: The company received only the compatibility summary; the full pattern remains at the yard and aboard the ship.

zh_CN: 材料交付尚未完成。可自由移动；再次与伊娅交互即可继续对白。
en: Material delivery is incomplete. You may move freely; interact with Iya again to continue.

zh_CN: 伊娅确认屏蔽外层稳定；老皮仍把铭牌回波标为未解析。
en: Iya confirms the shielding layer is stable; Lao Pi still marks the plaque echo as unresolved.

zh_CN: 返站前必须完成材料校准，并明确改装记录的提交范围。
en: Complete material calibration and choose the record scope before returning.

zh_CN: 赤砂回访 · 改装完成
完整改装记录已交公司存档。屏蔽层安装完成，铭牌回波仍保持“未解析”。
en: The full retrofit record was archived by the company. Shielding is installed; the plaque echo remains unresolved.

zh_CN: 公司收到兼容测试摘要，完整纹路留在维修场与飞船。伊娅对你的信任有所增加。
en: The company received a compatibility summary while the full pattern stayed at the yard and aboard the ship. Iya's trust increased.

zh_CN: 旧档案终端已获得接通条件 · 特高压电屏蔽罩已安装到防护槽
en: The legacy archive terminal now has what it needs to connect · High-voltage shielding installed in the defense slot

zh_CN: 白噪星章节已开启；回站后先和老皮接通旧终端，再确认屏蔽罩仍在防护槽。
en: The White Noise chapter is open. Return to the station, connect the legacy terminal with Lao Pi, then confirm the shielding remains in the defense slot.

zh_CN: 白噪中的索引
档案层的一组关键索引在电磁暴雪后失效。
en: A critical archive index failed after an electromagnetic blizzard.

zh_CN: 当地维护者要求恢复服务时保留最小访问原则。
en: Local maintainers require minimum-access rules during restoration.

zh_CN: 公司希望把修复接口并入跨文明档案服务。
en: The company wants the repair interface folded into its inter-civilization archive service.

zh_CN: 失效索引关联具体家庭与个人记忆，不是匿名业务数据。
en: The failed index links to specific families and personal memories, not anonymous business data.

zh_CN: 接入冷核会同时恢复检索，并把批量访问权限交给目的地现场决定。
en: Installing the cryocore restores search while leaving the bulk-access decision to the destination team.

zh_CN: 迁徙季的陌生气味
en: A Strange Scent in Migration Season

zh_CN: 幼林病害隔离窗口与本季生物迁徙路线重叠。
en: A juvenile-grove isolation window overlaps this season's wildlife migration.

zh_CN: 树冠航路协调者要求外来货物申报生物信号。
en: The canopy route coordinator requires biosignal declarations for incoming cargo.

zh_CN: 公司将样本归类为普通生态研究货物。
en: The company classifies the sample as ordinary ecological research cargo.

zh_CN: 把风交给谁
天气塔故障正在压缩岛链之间的安全航行窗口。
en: Weather-tower failures are shrinking safe travel windows between islands.

zh_CN: 多个城邦与联盟对控制接口提出不同方案。
en: Several city-states and alliances propose different control arrangements.

zh_CN: 公司提出临时托管并要求获得航路数据访问权。
en: The company offers temporary custody in exchange for route-data access.

zh_CN: 被退回的记忆盒
记忆盒来自一户已经迁出档案层的家庭。
en: The memory case belongs to a family that moved away from the archive layer.

zh_CN: 公司曾建议将它转入商业托管。
en: The company previously suggested transferring it into commercial custody.

zh_CN: 持有人多次要求只归还，不建立公开索引。
en: The owner repeatedly requested return without a public index.

zh_CN: 孢子季急投
树冠诊疗点无法为普通飞船提供安全着陆面。
en: The canopy clinic cannot provide a safe landing surface for a standard ship.

zh_CN: 自动货运会扰动孢子流和迁徙生物。
en: Automated freight would disturb spore flows and migrating wildlife.

zh_CN: 固定接收环允许一次宽容的低空释放。
en: A fixed receiving ring allows a forgiving low-altitude release.

zh_CN: 风眼前的灯
民用航标服务普通客运与渔业航线。
en: The civilian beacons serve ferry and fishing routes.

zh_CN: 维护队预算长期低于天气塔核心项目。
en: The maintenance crew's budget has long ranked below weather-tower core work.

zh_CN: 下一段风墙到来前仍有一段宽松交付窗口。
en: A forgiving delivery window remains before the next wind wall.

zh_CN: 赤砂星
低水资源沙漠殖民地；居民维修系统与公司配额记录之间存在长期矛盾。
en: A low-water desert colony where resident maintenance needs conflict with company quota records.

zh_CN: 伊娅
负责居民冷却与净水系统的维护者，也是旧中继铭牌的保管人之一。
en: A maintainer of residential cooling and water systems, and one custodian of the old relay plaque.

zh_CN: 旧中继铭牌
从赤砂维修场带回的旧铭牌，其协议纹路早于公司现行标准。
en: An old plaque from the Red Sand repair yard whose protocol pattern predates current company standards.

zh_CN: 中继纹屏蔽材料
依据旧铭牌结构制作的屏蔽层，用于飞船高压电防护改装。
en: Shielding layers patterned after the old plaque for a high-voltage ship retrofit.

zh_CN: 依据旧铭牌结构制作的高压屏蔽层。完整改装纹路已上传公司，铭牌产生的异常回波仍未解析。
en: High-voltage shielding patterned after the old plaque. The full retrofit record was uploaded to the company; the plaque's anomalous echo remains unresolved.

zh_CN: 依据旧铭牌结构制作的高压屏蔽层。公司仅保存兼容测试摘要，完整纹路保留在赤砂维修场与飞船本地。
en: High-voltage shielding patterned after the old plaque. The company holds only a compatibility summary; the full pattern remains at the Red Sand yard and aboard the ship.

zh_CN: 旧铭牌异常回波
校准时出现的断续回波无法被公司设备解析；现阶段只能确认它与旧铭牌纹路同步，来源和含义均未确定。
en: A broken echo during calibration cannot be parsed by company equipment. For now, only its synchronization with the old plaque pattern is confirmed; its source and meaning remain unknown.

zh_CN: 白噪星
冰下文明以记忆保存为公共设施，也争论访问、删除与长期保留的权利。
en: An under-ice civilization treats memory preservation as infrastructure while debating access, deletion, and long-term retention.

zh_CN: 弥珥
负责恢复失效索引，同时反对未经授权的商业批量访问。
en: An archive maintainer restoring a failed index while resisting unauthorized commercial bulk access.

zh_CN: 记忆索引冷核
既能修复档案索引，也携带关于访问权的技术选择。
en: A core that repairs an archive index while carrying technical choices about access rights.

zh_CN: 诺芮
代表家人取回私人记录，并要求归还不等于公开。
en: A representative reclaiming family records and insisting that return does not mean publication.

zh_CN: 被退回的记忆盒
因授权记录不完整而被退回的私人档案容器。
en: A private archive container returned because its authorization record was incomplete.

zh_CN: 穹林星
巨树树冠承载城市、航路和迁徙窗口，外来物流必须面对生态关系。
en: Giant canopies carry cities, routes, and migration windows, requiring off-world logistics to respect ecological ties.

zh_CN: 苔音
根据风、孢子和生物叫声协调树冠航线与幼林隔离。
en: A route keeper coordinating canopy lanes and grove isolation by wind, spores, and wildlife calls.

zh_CN: 菌根迁徙样本舱
关系到幼林病害隔离的生态样本，其信号会吸引本地生物。
en: An ecological sample tied to juvenile-grove disease isolation whose signals attract local wildlife.

zh_CN: 芽洛
处理孢子季呼吸问题并负责诊疗点低空接收环。
en: A clinic worker treating spore-season respiratory problems and operating the low-altitude receiving ring.

zh_CN: 孢子稳定剂舱
供狭窄树冠诊疗点使用的生态与医疗稳定剂。
en: An ecological and medical stabilizer for a clinic in the narrow canopy.

zh_CN: 群潮星
共享天气塔技术的岛屿城邦把公共航路、安全与控制权绑在同一网络上。
en: Island city-states sharing weather-tower technology bind public routes, safety, and control to one network.

zh_CN: 娜茵
维护民用航路与天气塔，关注被主航线遗忘的小岛。
en: A weather-tower maintainer protecting civilian routes and islands overlooked by major lanes.

zh_CN: 天气塔共识钥
恢复塔网的控制组件，其授权模式决定航路与天气数据的管理者。
en: A tower-network control component whose authorization mode determines who manages routes and weather data.

zh_CN: 维澜
理解集中调度效率，也要求说明公开监督与控制权的代价。
en: A route-alliance representative who understands centralized efficiency while demanding accountability for control.

zh_CN: 民用航标电池组
在风墙到来前恢复普通客运和渔业航标的耐候电池。
en: Weatherproof cells restoring ferry and fishing beacons before the next wind wall.

zh_CN: 旧中继铭牌
维修场交给玩家保存的旧铭牌，表面留有无法归入公司标准的中继纹路。
en: An old plaque entrusted to the courier, bearing relay patterns outside company standards.

zh_CN: 霜纹索引片
档案维护者留下的只读索引片，霜纹会随附近设备声响变化。
en: A read-only index shard whose frost pattern shifts with nearby machinery sounds.

zh_CN: 树冠航路风铃
用迁徙季安全航路材料编成的小风铃，只在合适风向下发声。
en: A small chime woven from safe-route materials that sounds only in the right wind.

zh_CN: 天气塔微型风向标
维护队制作的微型风向标，刻着一条普通民用航路的编号。
en: A miniature vane made by the maintenance crew and marked with a civilian route number.

zh_CN: 索引状态：私人记录保持封存，仅保留交付校验摘要。\n中继协议修订记录早于公司接口 37 年；这只证明协议早于公司，创造者与用途仍未知。

zh_CN: 索引状态：本地档案站与持有人共同保管访问密钥。\n中继协议修订记录早于公司接口 37 年；这只证明协议早于公司，创造者与用途仍未知。

zh_CN: 记忆持有人代理已确认本次索引安排；主线仍汇入同一返航流程。
en: The memory owner's representative acknowledged the index arrangement; the mainline still rejoins the same return flow.

zh_CN: 目的地交付已完成；返航升降梯已准备接入订单结算。

zh_CN: 请先完成档案访问选择，再启动返航升降梯。

zh_CN: 白噪星档案交互暂不可用。
en: The White Noise archive interaction is temporarily unavailable.

zh_CN: 档案交付已确认 · 正在返回快递站结算
en: Archive delivery confirmed · returning to the station for settlement

zh_CN: 返航链路暂时不可用，请重新启动升降梯。
en: The return link is temporarily unavailable; activate the lift again.

zh_CN: 冷核温度稳定。把它接入三号交付座，我只恢复这次获准的索引层。
en: Cryocore temperature is stable. Connect it to cradle three; I will restore only the index layer authorized for this delivery.

zh_CN: 这里的马达失效前会先变调，霜纹也会偏向故障扇区。我每天把两种变化逐项记在纸质值班册里，停电时仍能核对。
en: The motors change pitch before failing, and frost patterns lean toward the failing sector. I log both in a paper duty ledger so they remain checkable during outages.

zh_CN: 公司运输让替换冷核准时到达，这一点必要。但它把“能接入”写成“可批量访问”，我不会替任何未授权的商业读取背书。
en: Company transport got the replacement cryocore here on time, which was necessary. But it writes 'can connect' as 'may bulk-access'; I will not endorse unauthorized commercial reading.

zh_CN: 这批记录里有我家人临终前反复改过的一段留言。建立索引能帮助找回它，也可能让一次搜索改写别人理解他的方式。
en: These records include a message my family member revised repeatedly before death. An index can help recover it, but one search result can also reshape how others understand him.

zh_CN: 冷核还带回一条旧的中继协议修订号，比公司最早的接口记录早三十七年。它只能证明这套协议早于公司；创造者和真实用途都无法从这条记录判断。
en: The cryocore also recovered an old relay-protocol revision number, thirty-seven years older than the company's earliest interface record. It proves only that the protocol predates the company; neither creator nor true purpose can be inferred from it.

zh_CN: 交付权限只够决定这一批记录的本地访问方式。选择会写入关系、图鉴与后续对白，但不会阻塞主线返航。
en: Delivery authority covers only the local access mode for this batch. The choice affects relationship, codex, and follow-up dialogue, but never blocks the mainline return.

zh_CN: 公开最低限度索引：只列标题与归属
en: Publish a minimum index: titles and ownership only

zh_CN: 保持封存：仅保存交付校验摘要
en: Keep sealed: retain only the delivery checksum

zh_CN: 本地共同保管：档案站与持有人共享密钥
en: Local shared custody: archive and owner share the key

zh_CN: 我会把索引字段限制在标题与归属，正文继续需要持有人授权。
en: I will restrict index fields to title and ownership; record bodies will still require owner authorization.

zh_CN: 那段留言不会进入搜索结果。至少今天，我不必先向一份目录解释我的家人。
en: That message will not enter search results. At least today, I do not have to explain my family to a directory first.

zh_CN: 共享密钥让我们都无法单方面公开。我愿意为每次访问留下签名。
en: A shared key prevents either side from publishing alone. I am willing to sign every access.

zh_CN: 访问模式已经写入本地索引。交付成立，三种选择都从同一座升降梯返航。
en: The access mode is recorded in the local index. Delivery is valid, and all three choices return through the same lift.

zh_CN: 标题里仍有足以辨认我家人的信息，但正文没有开放。我会观察这份最低索引实际被谁使用。
en: The titles still reveal enough to identify my family, but the records themselves remain closed. I will watch who actually uses this minimum index.

zh_CN: 封存不是删除。等家人准备好时，记录还在；今天不会先被一份公共目录定义。
en: Sealing is not deletion. The records remain for when the family is ready, without being defined by a public directory today.

zh_CN: 共同保管意味着我也要承担维护责任。下一次轮值，我会带一份新的离线密钥清单。
en: Shared custody means I also carry maintenance responsibility. On my next shift, I will bring an updated offline key ledger.

zh_CN: 谢谢你把交付当成一次具体授权，而不是替所有人作出的永久决定。
en: Thank you for treating delivery as a specific authorization, not a permanent decision made for everyone.

zh_CN: 白噪索引：最低公开方案
本次交付只公开记录标题与归属，正文仍需持有人授权。随冷核恢复的协议修订号比公司最早接口早 37 年；它不说明创造者或真实用途。
en: This delivery published only record titles and ownership; record bodies still require holder authorization. A restored protocol revision predates the company's earliest interface by 37 years, without identifying its creator or true purpose.

zh_CN: 白噪索引：封存方案
私人记录保持封存，公司仅获得交付校验摘要。旧协议修订号仍只证明中继协议早于公司标准，不能据此推断来源。
en: Private records remain sealed, and the company received only a delivery checksum. The old protocol revision proves only that the relay protocol predates company standards; it does not establish an origin.

zh_CN: 白噪索引：共同保管方案
档案站与持有人共同保管访问密钥，任何一方都不能单独公开记录。协议年代线索被保留为未解析记录，不扩展为中继网起源结论。
en: The archive and memory holder share custody of the access key, so neither side can publish alone. The protocol-age clue remains unresolved and does not become a claim about the relay network's origin.

zh_CN: 白噪星 · 档案交付完成
最低索引已发布；正文继续受持有人授权保护。白噪星关系小幅提升，旧协议年代线索已归档。
en: The minimum index was published while record bodies remain holder-authorized. White Noise relations improved slightly, and the old protocol-age clue was archived.

zh_CN: 私人记录保持封存，公司只收到交付摘要。当地对你尊重具体授权的做法给予额外信任。
en: Private records remain sealed, and the company received only the delivery summary. Local trust increased further because you respected the specific authorization.

zh_CN: 访问密钥改由档案站与持有人共同保管。当地对可追溯的共同授权给予额外信任。
en: Access-key custody is now shared by the archive and memory holder. Local trust increased further for choosing traceable shared authorization.

zh_CN: 旧档案终端已同步白噪索引 · 档案许可、选择记录、图鉴与霜纹索引纪念品已保存
en: The legacy archive terminal synced the White Noise index · archive permission, choice record, codex, and frost-index souvenir saved

zh_CN: 穹林星前置信息已出现；回站可查看更新后的档案终端，白噪星也留下了一条自愿回访线索。
en: The Canopy precursor is now available. Back at the station, inspect the updated archive terminal; White Noise also left an optional revisit lead.

zh_CN: 私人记忆盒封条完整 · 强烈冲击会降低报酬与当地信任。

zh_CN: 记忆盒保持封存；极光暴雪与主航路使用同一套风险规则。

zh_CN: 短航段完成 · 切换到私人返件交付。
en: Short route complete · switching to the private return handoff.

zh_CN: 这不是公司催办的主线。你接了，咱们就把盒子送回具体的人；你没接，穹林星也照常开放。
en: This is not a company-mandated mainline job. If you take it, we return the case to a specific person; if not, Canopy still opens normally.

zh_CN: 航路从极光暴雪段切入，后面复用档案站进场。少飞一半，不代表记忆盒更耐撞。
en: The route starts at the aurora-blizzard leg and reuses the archive approach. Half the distance does not make the memory case impact-proof.

zh_CN: 我把旧航迹裁到后半段了：暴雪、档案入口、着陆，没再复制一条新航路。
en: I trimmed the verified course to its latter half: blizzard, archive entrance, and landing, without duplicating another route.

zh_CN: 归还只能证明物件到了谁手里，不能替持有人决定它应不应该进入目录。
en: Return proves who received the object; it does not decide whether the holder should enter it into a catalog.

zh_CN: 公司回执只写“授权不完整，退回客户”，并建议改用商业托管。
en: The company receipt says only “authorization incomplete, return to customer,” and recommends commercial custody.

zh_CN: 持有人连续三次回复同一句：只归还，不要先替我们建立公开索引。
en: The holder replied with the same sentence three times: return it, and do not create a public index for us first.

zh_CN: 盒内是迁居前留下的家庭记录，不是批量档案修复件。封条记录每一次冲击。
en: The case holds family records from before relocation, not a bulk archive repair component. Its seal logs every impact.

zh_CN: 封条允许核对容器身份，不允许公司、我们或档案站提前打开内容。
en: The seal permits container verification, not advance access by the company, us, or the archive.

zh_CN: 盒子里是我们迁居前最后一个冬季的餐桌录音。档案层把它退回时，没有人问我们想留下什么。
en: The case holds our dinner-table recordings from the last winter before we moved. When the archive returned it, no one asked what we wanted preserved.

zh_CN: 里面有坏掉的加热器声、孩子把杯子碰倒的声音，还有我们已经不用的旧门铃。它们不需要先变成公共故事。
en: It contains a broken heater, a child knocking over a cup, and an old door chime we no longer use. They do not need to become a public story first.

zh_CN: 封条校验通过，但旧授权只写了“家庭共同持有”。我们可以归还，也可以在你们明确同意后留下有限索引。
en: The seal verifies, but the old authorization says only “shared by the family.” We can return it, or retain a limited index after your explicit consent.

zh_CN: 请把归还方式写清楚。以后有人检索时，我不想再由一条默认规则替我们回答。
en: Write the return terms clearly. I do not want a default rule answering for us when someone searches later.

zh_CN: 完全私密归还，不建立任何可搜索索引。
en: Return it completely privately, with no searchable index.

zh_CN: 只记录匿名容器索引，不记录姓名、内容或家庭关系。
en: Create only an anonymous container index, without names, contents, or family relationships.

zh_CN: 归还可读副本，原件继续由当地封存保管。
en: Return a readable copy while the original remains sealed in local custody.

zh_CN: 这样就够了。它回到我们手里，不需要先证明自己对别人有用。
en: That is enough. It returns to us without first proving its usefulness to anyone else.

zh_CN: 索引只会记录容器校验号与归还日期。无法从目录反推姓名、内容或家庭。
en: The index will contain only the container checksum and return date. Names, contents, and family cannot be inferred from it.

zh_CN: 副本让我们现在能听见，原件留在这里应对介质损坏。每次读取仍要我们的新授权。
en: The copy lets us listen now, while the original stays here against media failure. Every access still requires new authorization from us.

zh_CN: 归还条款已写入本次交付记录。这份支线到此结束，不会改变下一份主线订单。
en: The return terms are recorded for this delivery. This side story ends here and does not alter the next main order.

zh_CN: 可选返件短航段 · 已复用白噪主航路后半段
en: Optional return leg · reusing the latter half of the White Noise main route

zh_CN: 自愿支线 · 复用暴雪、档案入口与着陆段 · 货损会减少报酬和关系
en: Optional side order · reuses blizzard, archive entrance, and landing · cargo damage reduces payout and relations

zh_CN: 记忆盒短航段完成 · 正在接入私人返件柜台
en: Memory-case short route complete · connecting to the private return counter

zh_CN: 白噪星 · 私人记忆返件柜台
en: White Noise · Private Memory Return Counter

zh_CN: 自愿人物支线 · 复用冰下档案区域
en: Optional character side story · reusing the under-ice archive area

粗糙对接 · 记忆盒完整度 %d%%
确认归还条款后，可查看返件记录或直接返回升降梯。
en: After confirming the return terms, inspect the return record or go directly to the lift.

记忆盒封条只开放容器校验；内容仍由持有人授权。
en: The memory-case seal exposes only container verification; content remains holder-authorized.

zh_CN: 维护者只登记本次明确授权，不把支线选择升级为默认档案规则。
en: The maintainer records only this explicit authorization and does not turn the side-order choice into a default archive rule.

zh_CN: 返件记录：完全私密归还 · 无可搜索索引。
en: Return record: completely private return · no searchable index.

zh_CN: 返件记录：仅匿名容器校验号与日期 · 无姓名、内容或家庭关系。
en: Return record: anonymous container checksum and date only · no names, contents, or family relationships.

zh_CN: 返件记录：可读副本归还持有人 · 原件继续由当地封存。
en: Return record: readable copy returned to the holder · original remains sealed locally.

zh_CN: 持有人确认本次归还条款，不要求你继续处理其他档案。
en: The holder confirms the return terms and asks for no further archive work.

zh_CN: 私人返件已完成；可以返回空间站结算这份自愿支线。
en: Private return complete; you may return to the station to settle this optional side order.

zh_CN: 请先与持有人明确本次记忆盒的归还方式。
en: First confirm the memory case return terms with the holder.

zh_CN: 私人返件已确认 · 正在返回空间站结算
en: Private return confirmed · returning to the station for settlement

zh_CN: 白噪星支线 · 私人返件完成
en: White Noise Side Order · Private Return Complete

zh_CN: 记忆盒完全私密地回到持有人手中，没有留下可搜索目录。
en: The memory case returned privately to its holder with no searchable catalog entry.

zh_CN: 档案站只保留匿名容器校验号与归还日期，无法从索引反推家庭。
en: The archive retains only an anonymous container checksum and return date, with no path back to the family.

zh_CN: 持有人取得可读副本，原件继续由当地封存；后续读取仍需新授权。
en: The holder received a readable copy while the original remains sealed locally; future access still requires new authorization.

zh_CN: 记忆盒封条状态良好 · 获得完整白噪关系奖励。
en: Memory-case seal remained in good condition · full White Noise relation reward earned.

zh_CN: 记忆盒完整度低于 %d%% · 信用点已按货损减少，白噪关系奖励抵消 %d。
en: Memory-case integrity fell below %d%% · payout was reduced by damage and the White Noise relation reward was reduced by %d.

zh_CN: 记忆持有人与记忆盒图鉴已按本次归还条款更新
en: The memory holder and memory-case codex entries now reflect this return agreement

zh_CN: 这份自愿支线已经归档；无论完成、失败或放弃，穹林星主线资格都不受影响。
en: This optional side order is archived; completion, failure, or abandonment does not affect Canopy mainline eligibility.

zh_CN: 代表家人取回私人记录，并选择不留下任何可搜索索引。归还没有被解释成公开许可。
en: A representative reclaimed the family records without leaving any searchable index. Return was not treated as permission to publish.

zh_CN: 代表家人取回私人记录，并同意只留下无法反推身份的匿名容器校验号与日期。
en: A representative reclaimed the family records and allowed only an anonymous container checksum and date that cannot reveal identity.

zh_CN: 代表家人取得可读副本，同时让原件继续由当地封存；每次访问仍需新的具体授权。
en: A representative received a readable copy while the original remains sealed locally; every access still requires specific new authorization.

zh_CN: 因授权记录不完整而被退回的私人档案容器。它已完全私密地归还，没有建立搜索索引。
en: A private archive container returned because its authorization was incomplete. It was returned privately with no searchable index.

zh_CN: 因授权记录不完整而被退回的私人档案容器。档案站只保留匿名校验号和归还日期。
en: A private archive container returned because its authorization was incomplete. The archive retains only an anonymous checksum and return date.

zh_CN: 因授权记录不完整而被退回的私人档案容器。可读副本已归还，原件继续由当地封存。
en: A private archive container returned because its authorization was incomplete. A readable copy was returned while the original remains sealed locally.
